jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d) (Biophysiker/in)
jobs.description: A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking aPostdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.Your roles:- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.Your profile:- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.- Very good communication skills in English.We offer:- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.- Transparent opportunities for career development.- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.- A family-friendly working place.- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.The position is initially for 2 years.Interested?We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Development Lead (m/w/d) (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin und Hämatologie und Onkologie)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionLead the Future of Medicine - as Clinical Development Lead in Oncology.To ensure the fastest and most focused path from strategy to patients, we are evolving our OneHP organization. Together, we are simplifying our structures, strengthening the accountability of Therapeutic Areas, and creating clear interfaces between Innovation and Business. This ensures that our assets are efficiently transformed into successful brands - with the ultimate goal of delivering lasting value to patients around the world.We are looking for an experienced physician-scientist to lead the clinical development of an innovative oncology asset. In this role, you will provide strategic and scientific leadership across clinical development activities, shape the development strategy, and guide cross-functional teams through key development and regulatory milestones.This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.Tasks & responsibilities- Drive the clinical development strategy for a post-Proof-of-Concept oncology asset, ensuring alignment with scientific, regulatory, access, and commercial objectives.- Develop and continuously evolve a high-quality Clinical Development Plan in the context of holistic evidence generation and lifecycle management.- Contribute to key asset strategy deliverables, including the Target Product Profile, Integrated Evidence Plan, and Global Brand Plan.- Guide strategic decision-making through insight generation, evidence interpretation, and cross-functional collaboration.- Represent Clinical Development within the Global Brand Team, governance bodies, and senior leadership committees.- Lead and develop a team of (Senior) Clinical Program Leads, Study Physicians, and Scientific Project Coordinators assigned to the asset.Requirements- MD or PhD with extensive clinical and scientific experience in Oncology or Hematology.- Long-term experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry and/or equivalent experience in academic clinical research.- Several years of experience in a leadership role within a global matrix environment.- Strong understanding of the lifecycle of medicinal products, including development, registration, launch, and lifecycle management.- Proven experience interacting with global regulatory authorities, including FDA and EMA.- Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to drive complex decisions and lead effectively under pressure.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 7 December 2026.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from beginning of November 2026Step 3: On-site interviews beginning mid of November 2026Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.description: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! Join ESMC and help shape the future of Europe’s semiconductor industry!Are you passionate about connecting people with opportunities and making recruitment processes run smoothly? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment where teamwork, ownership, and adaptability make a real difference?At ESMC, we are building more than a state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing facility in Dresden. We are building the team behind it.To support our growing organization, we are looking for a hands-on Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) who enjoys managing recruitment activities from start to finish, building strong relationships with hiring managers, and creating a positive candidate experience. and talent markets.• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and changing priorities.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, Office applications and applicant tracking systems, with an openness to learning new tools and processes.• Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken; Mandarin would be an advantage.• Confidence working in an international and culturally diverse environment, including occasional meetings across different time zones.• Willingness to travel occasionally for recruitment events and
